title: The `blacklist_user_ix` instruction skips `is_blacklisted` update
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `super_admin` can call the `blacklist_user_ix` instruction to refund the tokens purchased by `user_state`, but the contract does not update the `is_blacklisted` flag in `user_state` to `true`, which fails to prevent this user from continuing to purchase tokens.  ## Recommendations  Set the `is_blacklisted` flag of `user_state` to `true` in the `blacklist_user_ix` instruction. ```diff pub fn blacklist_user_ix<'a, 'b, 'c, 'info>(     ctx: Context<'a, 'b, 'c, 'info, BlacklistUser<'info>>, ) -> Result<()> {     //... +
